title: Drones and warehouse screens in FPVBuddy, built with bricks
goal: FPVBuddy has its own drones and warehouse (spares) screens for NERV to open
acceptance: FPVBuddy gains a drones screen (drones, part slots and status, recent crashes) and a warehouse screen (spares by category, new and used counts) on the F-010 core, built with 🧱 bricks tokens, components and patterns from the start, with no local override
Pieces bricks lacks follow F-008's rule (a bricks PR, or listed as FPVBuddy-only in docs/STYLE-GUIDE.md); specs and build pass
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
A surface type or page bricks lacks goes to bricks as a proposal, never a local copy in NERV

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: two list screens on the battery view's bricks patterns. Not a measurement.
